title: 瑞银李慧：内地财政支持已宣布，市场为何没有积极反应
speaker: Eva Lee

segments.en: Well, a few factors that will affect the global in China market.
segments.zh: 有几个因素会影响全球和内地市场。

segments.en: Firstly, the 10-year yield, not just US, I guess, is all across the world now.
segments.zh: 首先，十年期收益率不只是美国，现在全球都在变化。

segments.en: And we all know that, I mean, 101, higher yield, not good for equity valuations, first thing, right?
segments.zh: 我们都知道，收益率走高对权益资产估值不利，这是第一点。

segments.en: Second, of course, now we start to see higher rates in overseas market, how it will affect all these fundamental like housing markets, how much investments that people want to put in, right? Okay, so that's one layer.
segments.zh: 第二，海外市场利率走高，会影响地产市场等基本面，以及人们愿意投入多少。这是一层。

segments.en: Second layer, it's China domestic layer. We have heard about the fiscal support that they announced last week.
segments.zh: 第二层是内地层面。我们听到了上周宣布的财政支持。

segments.en: Market, it's very calm, not reacted positively.
segments.zh: 市场非常平静，没有积极反应。

segments.en: I guess it's people realize that this measures, you know, takes time, you know, we need to push our more infrastructure, that's quite sure, but how much of a housing, you know, support could really affect, you know, the sentiment.
segments.zh: 我想人们意识到这些措施需要时间，需要推动更多基础设施，但地产方面的支持能多大程度影响情绪，还不确定。

segments.en: You think more of subsidies and what they're offering, it doesn't do enough to really
segments.zh: 更多补贴和提供的措施，可能还不够真正起作用。

segments.en: well, I think it's talking about 3%, I mean, the concern people have now, buying or not buying is no longer just giving me 3%, we'll jump into a buyer, it's, you know, my concern
segments.zh: 谈到3%，现在人们的担忧是，买不买不再只是给3%就会入场，而是我的担忧。

segments.en: of job security regarding whether property prices are really, you know, stabilized here, you know, that's all the important factors rather than just 3%, I mean, given that markets
segments.zh: 关于工作保障，以及地产估值是否真的趋稳，这些才是重要因素，而不只是3%。

segments.en: have not moved much on the back of that mini stimulus, if you will, do you think this is sending enough pressure to the government, perhaps for more stimulus to come in the last
segments.zh: 市场在小型刺激后没有太大变动，你认为这是否给政府足够压力，可能在最后阶段推出更多刺激？

segments.en: quarter because we have another standing committee meeting in October, early November, right?
segments.zh: 因为十月、十一月初还有另一次常委会会议，对吧？
